# The Demand Engineer

Matt Danese is a senior demand generation manager and AI systems builder. This site documents AI automation systems for B2B SaaS demand generation, with publicly available prompts, frameworks, and build breakdowns.

## Prompt Library
A free, ungated collection of 15 production-grade Claude prompts for B2B SaaS demand generation. Each prompt comes from a documented AI system used in real demand gen programs. Categories covered:

- Paid Media Reporting & Analysis: weekly summaries, CPL anomaly detection, budget reallocation, exec summary generation
- Attribution & Tracking: attribution audit and diagnostic
- Lead Quality & ICP Analysis: ICP scoring rubric, ad creative audit, bad lead pattern detection
- RevOps & Marketing Operations: Marketo nurture diagnostic, sales enablement package
- A/B Testing & Creative: ad copy variant generation with expert panel scoring, hypothesis generation, test result interpretation
- Strategic Briefs & Pipeline: campaign brief, pipeline gap analysis

Full prompt library: https://thedemandengineer.com/prompts/

## Topics Covered
- AI-powered paid media automation
- Lead scoring and ICP qualification using AI
- B2B attribution tracking architecture (GCLID, OCI, Enhanced Conversions)
- Marketo audit and lead routing diagnostics
- A/B testing with AI-generated variants and pre-launch expert panel scoring
- Demand gen reporting automation
- Pipeline gap diagnostics
- Sales enablement from new content offers

## Editorial Approach
All content is grounded in real production systems. Prompts include the actual rubrics, judgment rules, and failure modes from documented work. No theoretical AI content — only what's been built and used in B2B demand gen programs.
